about_the_game:
Choose from 37 international teams and hear the crowd cheer you on as you outplay your opponent. Single, Multi-player, and Tournament Modes. Play on 13 different courts around the world as you pass, assist, attack, block and dig your way to the championships and bring home the trophy for your country.

It’s a battle of the sexes! Play with both male and female teammates on the same team and show your competition who’s boss!

The choice is yours! Customize your characters by changing facial expressions and features, hair styles and hair color! Have your characters wear stylish sunglasses or a hat!

Play at your own pace! Choose from 4 different speed modes tailored to each player’s individual skill level. Perfect for all ages!

- Single, Multi-player, Tournament, and Expert Modes of play.
- Position your players for offensive and defensive plays
- Choose from 37 International teams!
- Play on 13 different exotic courts around the world, including the North Pole!
- Multi-Player plays across PC, IOS, and Android, systems.
- Fully Immersive 3D Graphics and Animations.

Special features exclusive for Steam members.
